description: Defines custom SQLAlchemy types and utility functions for handling SQL types related to Superset models, specifically focusing on a custom currency type that handles legacy stringified JSON data.

classes.name: CurrencyType
classes.description: A custom SQLAlchemy type for handling currency data stored as JSON, with legacy support for stringified JSON and Python dict strings.

methods.name: _try_parse_currency
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string value into a JSON object or Python dict, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: parse_currency_string
methods.description: Parses a string into a dictionary representing currency info, handling nested stringified JSON or dict strings.

methods.name: process_result_value
methods.description: Converts database values into a Python dict, parsing stringified JSON or dict strings as needed.
